entities.name: Reya Dawnbringer
entities.description: One of the first Serra Angels, leader and champion during the Phyrexian Invasion, able to resurrect fallen followers.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: Planeswalker who created the Serra Angels.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Called on the angels to abandon Serra's Realm and aid Dominaria.

entities.name: Radiant
entities.description: Archangel who rejected Urza's plans and turned radical.

entities.name: Lyra Dawnbringer
entities.description: Angelic leader inspired by Reya who founded the Order of Dawn.

entities.name: Order of Dawn
entities.description: Holy fellowship founded by Lyra in Reya's honor.

events.summary: Reya heeded Urza's call to leave Serra's Realm and aid Dominaria against Phyrexia.
events.quote: Reya and many of her fellow angels heeded Urza 's urgent call to abandon the safety of Serra's Realm

events.summary: Reya fought on the front lines to defend Benalia but was struck down.
events.quote: but was ultimately struck down during the brutal war

events.summary: Around 4560 AR Lyra Dawnbringer, inspired by Reya, founded the Order of Dawn in her honor.
events.quote: Lyra Dawnbringer , a great angelic leader who founded the Order of Dawn in Reya's honor

relations.note: One of the first Serra Angels she created.
relations.quote: one of the first Serra Angels ever created by the planeswalker Serra
Reya chose to stand with those who would carry Serra's light
founded the Order of Dawn in Reya's honor
